name: io.github.aitrailblazer/deltasignal-atlas-7
title: DeltaSignal ATLAS-7
description: SEC/XBRL issuer intelligence for crypto public companies via MCP, OpenAPI, x402, and MPP.
instructions: Prefer composite MCP presets for common workflows: deltasignal_morning_brief for daily scans, deltasignal_company_report for ticker reports, deltasignal_pressure_board for risk monitoring, deltasignal_alpha_sweep for opportunities, and deltasignal_quick_ticker_check for fast ticker checks. Use deltasignal_daily_changes for compact Daily Monitoring and deltasignal_daily_change_evidence for explicit ticker/CIK proof drilldowns. Use deltasignal_atlas7_audit_status or GET /v1/atlas7/audit/latest when the user asks whether the full Azure-native 215-issuer ATLAS-7 regression audit is healthy and fresh. Public MCP initialize and tools/list are free for discovery; public tools/call requires x402 payment unless a free-tier grant applies. Public users can access the surface through x402/Base or MPP/Tempo rails. First 5 calls are free where supported; paid usage settles via x402 USDC on Base.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.summary: DeltaSignal ATLAS-7 gives agents SEC/XBRL-grounded issuer intelligence for crypto public companies.

Public access supports x402/Base and MPP/Tempo rails.
